findings.surface: src/core/technique/TechniqueSystem.ts grant() L58-79; public entry src/core/game/GameManagerRealmAdvanceOps.ts grantCanonicalTechnique() L282-290
findings.title: Canonical-technique grant bypasses the betaTechniqueAdmitted scope gate
findings.detail: TechniqueSystem.grant() is the only holder-creation writer and the lone mutator in its class with no scope admission check. Siblings all gate: gainMastery (L97), sealFrozenCycle (L146), and the ops-level tryAdvanceTechniqueGrade (GameManagerRealmAdvanceOps L836-845, explicit betaTechniqueAdmitted). grant() checks only (a) same-id on a non-empty holder and (b) the grade ceiling (template.grade <= getTechniqueGradeCeiling(realmId) == realmIndex). There is no betaTechniqueAdmitted() call anywhere on the path GameManager.realmAdvanceOps.grantCanonicalTechnique -> techniqueSystem.grant -> manager.setActive.
findings.repro: tests/architecture/scopeWriteSeamsBlind.qa.test.ts :: 'grantCanonicalTechnique must refuse dormant canonical %s on an empty holder' (it.fails.each x5). Deterministic evidence: grantCanonicalTechnique('sword_control_art', player@qi_refining/empty-holder) returns true and techniqueManager.getActive().id === 'sword_control_art'. Succeeds for all five dormant canonical ids (dao_insight_art, sword_control_art, myriad_swords_art, diamond_body_art, responsive_body_art).
findings.mint_path: manager.realmAdvanceOps.grantCanonicalTechnique(techniqueId, player) -> techniqueSystem.grant(template, player.realmId) -> techniqueManager.setActive(structuredClone(template)) + publishProgress (techniqueProgress mirror write).
findings.producibility: NOT producible through authored beta flow or save ingress at ea406a1f: the mint requires an empty technique holder on a realmIndex>=1 player. Initiation always grants the canonical (chooseCultivationPath/commitFiveElementInitiation); save ingress rejects committed-way + techniques:[] at the shape layer ('realm >= qi_refining nhung techniques trong') and way-less non-mortal saves outright (probes pin both). Blast radius if the precondition ever becomes producible: a minted dormant canonical is suppressed by every downstream reader (TechniqueBand render filter, technique combat/tier modifiers, all mutators) but its save emission fails saveAcceptance's holder contract on the next boot (realm-committed save carrying a non-canonical id) - an authored write path that could produce an unbootable save.
findings.classification: defense-in-depth gate asymmetry; latent bypass, no live leak at pin

findings.title: Technique quality write is ungated on a dormant holder
findings.detail: setTechniqueQuality mutates the active holder's quality field with no betaTechniqueAdmitted check - on a flagged save it writes into the dormant-way technique record, which the scope contract says must stay frozen data. No production callers exist at pin (dead seam; header comment marks it as a reserved M5+ axis) and quality is display-level (no stat emission), so the mutation is inert.
findings.repro: tests/architecture/scopeWriteSeamsBlind.qa.test.ts :: 'setTechniqueQuality must refuse a dormant-way canonical' (it.fails). Deterministic evidence: dormant holder seated via restore(), setTechniqueQuality('thien') returns true and mutates .quality.
findings.mint_path: techniqueSystem.setTechniqueQuality('thien') -> technique.quality write on the dormant holder.
findings.producibility: Reachable whenever a dormant holder exists (a flagged sword/body/hidden save loads its canonical legitimately); the write itself is inert at pin (quality carries no live effect and no surface renders the dormant band).
findings.classification: dormant-state write without the sibling gate; inert consequence at pin

findings.title: Dev-tools seam bypasses beta roster admission and mints persisted perfect-clear claims
findings.detail: The DEV-gated window hook install carries two scope-bypassing writers: (a) spawnEnemy(enemyId) accepts ANY registered enemy template and launches a live turn battle through startBattleWithPlayer - BETA_ENEMY_ROSTER admission is never consulted, so hidden beasts (co_thu, huyet_mong) and non-roster foundation enemies enter live combat in a dev build; (b) forcePerfectClear(stageId, clearSeconds) pushes player.perfectClearStageIds and writes player.perfectClearSeconds[stageId] - persisted claims no authored writer produced (the only authored writer is a real combat victory), which then emit into every later save payload and relax the stage idle gate.
findings.repro: tests/architecture/scopeWriteSeamsBlind.qa.test.ts :: 'the DEV hook spawns a non-roster hidden beast live'. Runtime evidence (vitest, DEV=true, stubbed window): spawnEnemy('co_thu') -> 'spawned Co Thu' with turnBattle.state === 'intro'; forcePerfectClear('stage_qi_01') -> perfectClearStageIds=['stage_qi_01'], perfectClearSeconds={stage_qi_01:60}.
findings.mint_path: registerEnemySpawnDebug -> window.__tutienEnemySpawnDebug.spawnEnemy -> catalogOps.getEnemyTemplate -> applyEnemyTags -> gameManager.startBattleWithPlayer; forcePerfectClear -> direct PlayerData record writes.
findings.producibility: Unreachable in production builds: guarded by import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined' (the whole block is stripped at build time). Reachable in every dev/test context that provides window.
findings.classification: dev-only bypass; not a shippable defect - reported because devtools/admin paths are in the audit scope
